rationale: Linked Endcap derivation is already deep and pure in phase6_fold_profiles.
Variant K pushes workspace mutation and live-editor effect ordering back to a full-app caller.
Variant E can plan derivation/presence without forbidden imports, but cannot delete the old live-editor/Tk effect body.
Joining DerivedPartSyncPlan would mix canonical existing EndCap profile refresh with derived physical-part topology.
Deepening Fold Profiles would contaminate a pure derivation owner with workspace/Tk effects.
A new application coordinator would be a sequencing middle-man unless another accepted presentation owner absorbs the live-editor effects.
